thread:
alice (Support): FYI customer acme-inc reporting webhook failures after last night's model promotion. Structured output payloads are failing our parser — keys are showing mixed casing (userID vs userId) and arrays now sometimes contain the literal string \"null\" which breaks downstream validators. request_id=0a1b2c3d. @cara can you triage? :worried:

deploy-bot: Deployed model v7m -> stable at 2026-03-14T02:12:08Z (rollout 100%).

ben (SRE): I see a spike in 5xxs for /v1/chat/completions starting ~02:28 UTC, plus p95 up ~120ms. Pulling logs now — linking grafana: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abcdef/serving?from=now-1h

alice (Support): Customer says failures started ~02:30 UTC, they attached a failing example and said their webhook parser throws on first chunk. They've asked for ETA and whether we can roll back.

cara (ML Eng): Can you paste the exact response body they got? Specifically the top-level keys and a short snippet of the array with \"null\" strings. Also confirm if they were using structured_output=true or schema enforcement.

alice (Support): Pasting anonymized snippet below (their parser fails during JSON.parse):

```json
{
  "conversationId": "abc-123",
  "messages": [
    { "sender": "user", "userID": "u-789", "text": "..." },
    { "sender": "assistant", "userId": "u-789", "text": "..." }
  ],
  "entities": ["name", "null", "email"],
  "metadata": { "requestID": "0a1b2c3d" }
}
```

alice (Support): Note: keys are mixed camelCase and camelCase-with-capital-ID; the array has the string \"null\" not a JSON null. Customer validator expects consistent snake_case and real nulls.

cara (ML Eng): I can repro locally with v7m. Looks like a postprocessing regression: key canonicalization (we canonicalize to snake_case for structured outputs) was skipped for fields injected by the new system-tokens path. Also a recent change in the text normalizer turned Python None -> the literal string \"null\" when pruning empty slots in arrays.

cara (ML Eng): Short plan: 1) patch canonicalizer to run after all injected fields (ensures userID/userId -> user_id), 2) change array-prune to drop None instead of stringify, 3) add a quick unit test for webhook compatibility. I'll push a canary hotfix in ~10m. ETA to canary: 25-40m.

ben (SRE): I'll monitor deployment and temporarily add a rule to route acme-inc traffic to a test node if needed. If errors don't fall after the canary, we can failover to previous model tag. Also raising alerts for webhook 4xx/5xx so support can have clear SLA signals.

alice (Support): Thanks — I'll update the customer: letting them know we're rolling a canary hotfix and monitoring, offering to temporarily pause their traffic or accept a retry backoff if they'd prefer that. Will follow up in 30m or when you have results. :thumbsup:

support-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-3344 (structured-output webhook failures). Priority: P2. Owner: cara.

cara (ML Eng): hotfix pushed to canary at 2026-03-14T02:45Z. early signal shows reduced parse errors in canary traffic. Continuing rollout after 15m observation.

ben (SRE): Observability update: canary error rate down ~90%, p95 back to baseline. Keeping rollback plan ready.

alice (Support): Customer updated and appreciative of fast response, asked for postmortem when resolved. I'll keep the thread open and update the ticket.

cara (ML Eng): Will follow up with a short postmortem and the unit test added to prevent regression. Closing loop when stable deploy completes. :white_check_mark:
